name: The Outlet Shoppes at El Paso
summary: The Outlet Shoppes at El Paso is the region's only outlet shopping center, featuring over 100 name-brand stores including Nike, Coach, Brooks Brothers, and Banana Republic. This contemporary outlet mall offers family-friendly amenities like a kids' playground and splash pad, along with a food court, making it El Paso's favorite shopping destination for value-conscious shoppers.
demographics: The Outlet Shoppes at El Paso attracts a diverse mix of bargain-conscious shoppers from the El Paso metropolitan area and international visitors from nearby Ciudad Juárez, Mexico. The primary trade area serves middle-income families and value-seeking consumers, with a significant Hispanic population reflecting the border region's demographics. Shoppers typically range from young adults to families with children, drawn by the outlet pricing on name-brand merchandise. The center benefits from cross-border tourism, with Mexican nationals representing a substantial portion of weekend traffic seeking American brands at discounted prices.
description: The Outlet Shoppes at El Paso stands as the Sun City's premier outlet shopping destination, offering an unparalleled retail experience in the El Paso region. Located at 7051 South Desert Boulevard in Canutillo, this colorful and contemporary outlet mall features more than 100 name-brand stores including Nike, Coach, Brooks Brothers, Ann Taylor, Banana Republic, Johnston and Murphy, Crocs, and Boss. The center distinguishes itself with family-friendly amenities including a dedicated kids' playground and splash pad, making it an ideal destination for shoppers of all ages. Beyond its impressive tenant roster, the shopping center offers a comprehensive food court and various dining options to fuel shopping excursions. As the only outlet shopping center in the area, The Outlet Shoppes at El Paso has established itself as a must-visit destination for both local residents and tourists seeking premium brands at outlet prices, with convenient hours operating from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM Monday through Saturday and 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM on Sundays.
